With only 10 minutes of instruction, you’ll be prepared to make the jump with your instructor (who will be having just as much fun as you are!). Take a few minutes to view some videos of our tandem students making their first jumps, then give us a call to schedule your

blurb: Our dropzone for skydiving is conveniently located within an hour of New Orleans, Slidell, Hammond, Baton Rouge, Biloxi, Gulfport and Ocean Springs. Whether it’s your first jump or your one hundredth, we want you to come out and become a part of our skydiving family.
